title: Environment Setup for Fresh Deployment
purpose: Standard procedure for setting up a fresh environment from scratch. Covers Python installation, dependency management, Go binary compilation, directory initialization, and verification. Ensures every new team or deployment starts from a known-good state.

python_setup.title: Python 3 Setup
python_setup.overview: Python 3 is required for all coordination tools, research scripts, and test suites.

steps.if_missing: Install Python 3: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y python3 python3-pip python3-venv

steps.action: Install pytest for running test suites
Install any additional Python dependencies if a requirements.txt exists
steps.command: if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip install -r requirements.txt; fi

go_binary_compilation.title: Go Binary Compilation
go_binary_compilation.overview: Performance-critical tools are written in Go and must be compiled before use.

steps.if_missing: Install Go from https://go.dev/dl/ or via package manager

steps.action: Find all Go-based fast tools that need compilation

steps.command: for dir in storage/scripts/fast_*/; do (cd "$dir" && go build -o "$(basename $dir)" .); done
steps.note: Each fast_* directory should produce a binary named after the directory

steps.command: for dir in storage/scripts/fast_*/; do ls -la "$dir/$(basename $dir)"; done

directory_initialization.title: Directory Initialization
directory_initialization.overview: Ensure all required directories exist for coordination, bus messages, databases, and team outputs.

steps.command: mkdir -p storage/coordination/bus storage/coordination/db storage/coordination/teams storage/coordination/sops storage/coordination/tests storage/coordination/stress-tests

steps.action: Create knowledge base and market research directories
Set appropriate permissions on coordination database directory

database_initialization.title: Database Initialization
database_initialization.overview: Initialize the SQLite coordination database in WAL mode.

steps.action: Initialize the coordination database if it does not exist
steps.command: python3 -c "from storage.coordination.coordinator_hub import CoordinatorHub; hub = CoordinatorHub(); print('DB initialized')"
steps.fallback: If the import fails, the database will be auto-created on first use by any coordination tool

verification.title: Verification Commands
verification.overview: Run these commands to verify the environment is correctly set up.

steps.action: Run the test suite to verify coordination tools work
Verify Python imports work for all coordination modules
steps.command: python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'.'); from storage.coordination import help_protocol, direct_channels, work_stealing; print('All modules imported successfully')"
steps.expected: Success message with no import errors

steps.command: for dir in storage/scripts/fast_*/; do bin="$dir/$(basename $dir)"; if [ -x "$bin" ]; then echo "OK: $bin"; else echo "MISSING: $bin"; fi; done

steps.action: Run a quick smoke test of the full coordination stack
steps.command: python3 -c "from storage.coordination.coordinator_hub import CoordinatorHub; h = CoordinatorHub(); h.register_agent('test-agent', 'test-team'); print('Smoke test passed'); h.deregister_agent('test-agent')"

full_setup: Python 3.8+ installed and accessible as python3
Go compiler installed (if Go tools are needed)
Coordination directories created (bus/, db/, teams/, sops/)
Knowledge base and market research directories exist
SQLite database initialized in WAL mode
All Python coordination modules import without errors
Smoke test of coordinator hub passes
quick_verify: go version  (1.19+ if Go tools needed)
